scope: native unregistered production detector correction; registration repeats remain manual-only; no camera adapter

detectorPolicy.reference: protect compact passing boxes plus one pixel; learn all other pixels even during collection
detectorPolicy.persistence: independent patches; adjacent/overlapping boxes inherit state; merges/splits do not duplicate firing; source index gaps break pending confirmation
detectorPolicy.candidateUnit: all new compact patch runs, including several in one frame
detectorPolicy.firstFrame: initializes reference, no further disabled warm-up frames

method.fullRecordings: Each source streamed once into four interleaved fresh control/injected trials; raw coordinates, one-frame FWHM 5 injections
method.recovery: new candidate peak sample was actually brightened; every new candidate checked
method.timing: includes analysis/tracking/mask/reference update; excludes reading, injection/copy, clip snapshot, GUI and output; four trials interleaved per source frame
method.archiveCheck: read-only opens; size and modification time unchanged before/after each run (asserted, not a whole-file hash)
method.postMeasurementCodeChecks: all measured source indices contiguous and one-frame mode enabled; later pending-gap guard has no effect on these measurements

limitations: field acceptance remains partial; no suitable earthshine sequence identified
no universal sensitivity or false-impact-rate claim; K=6 still busy on unregistered terrain
single-frame recovery varies by position, time, K, connectivity, noise, and saturation
connected/overlapping activity may conceal a new rise within the same patch
RGB injected and control histories diverge substantially after an early pulse
short archive durations and selected injection settings are not recovery probabilities
registration remains outside production; cropped-prefix results do not establish long-run stability
payload ceiling excludes metadata and platform/codec overhead as documented for Feature-5
